description: If a relation has a witness below a specified bound, bounded search returns a value below that bound and unbounded search returns that same least witness.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.bounded_unbounded_agreement {k : ℕ}
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args (k + 1) → Prop)
  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (b : ℕ)
  (hex : ∃ i < b, P (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x i)) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.boundedPredicateSearch P x b ∈
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch P x ∧
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.boundedPredicateSearch P x b < b
